race.title: Join Fitzdares For A Personal Service Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: KING CALIFET went the right way in his 3 starts over fences last season, opening his chasing account at Newbury in March with the runner-up winning both races since. He is open to further progress on his return and is fancied to follow up, with Jet Smart feared most from only 1 lb above his last winning mark. Dangerous Touch completes the shortlist. KING CALIFET (IRE) JET SMART (IRE) DANGEROUS TOUCH (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: King Califet (2/1), Dangerous Touch (3/1), Le Galli Bier (5/1), Doctor Midas (8/1), Joe Cotton (10/1), Jet Smart (10/1), Loki's Mischief (10/1), Diligent Militia (25/1)
